purpose: Bounded live browser regression after the initial 8-question acceptance; keep original results unchanged.

authorization.scope: At most two browser questions using existing Attention/BERT knowledge base; query embedding and answer generation through the configured Aliyun Bailian API.

cases.question: 比较 Attention Is All You Need 与 BERT 的模型架构：前者是否包含编码器和解码器，后者采用什么结构？
checks: Evidence covers both Attention and BERT
Answer identifies Attention encoder-decoder and BERT bidirectional Transformer encoder
Attention claims cite Attention evidence and BERT claims cite BERT evidence
Citation buttons open the matching document/page/chunk

cases.question: BERT 的 MLM 选取多少比例的 token？选中后 MASK、随机替换、保持不变各占多少？
checks: Same conversation switches from comparison to BERT-only evidence
Answer distinguishes 15 percent selected from conditional 80/10/10 replacement ratios
No Attention or stale source attribution
Citation buttons open the matching BERT document/page/chunk

stop_rule: Never exceed two submissions or manually retry failed generation. Preserve failures and report them. Do not commit/push or alter frozen historical hashes.
